meta.name: tax
meta.description: Structures the tax questions a growing business faces — corporate income, sales and use, payroll, nexus, and the obligations created by hiring or selling somewhere new. Use this to work out what a new state or country obligates you to, prepare for a tax filing or audit, understand sales tax on your product, or check what a remote hire or new market triggers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 明确企业税务义务，备好报税与审计。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果企业正走向新市场,需要理清税务义务。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify your business tax obligations and prepare for filings and audits.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your growing business needs to understand tax duties in new jurisdictions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把涉税问题拆成清单，帮你理清在哪个州/国家销售、员工在哪工作、卖什么产品会带来哪些纳税义务，并提示哪些事项需要找税务顾问确认。
howto.when: 当你问某个新州或国家的纳税义务、准备报税或审计、想弄清产品该不该收销售税，或雇了远程员工、进入新市场时触发。

say.text: 我在德州新雇了一个远程员工，会触发哪些税？
say.note: Claude 会列出报税登记、预扣税和 nexus 等问题。

say.text: 我们的 SaaS 在加州要收销售税吗？
say.note: Claude 会说明服务税分类的差异，并提醒确认。

say.text: 公司去加拿大卖货，要办哪些登记？
say.note: Claude 会按地域帮你拆解义务清单。

howto.what_en: Claude structures tax questions into a checklist, clarifying which sales locations, remote hires, or product types create obligations, and flags what needs a tax adviser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about obligations in a new state/country, prepare for filing or audit, want to know sales tax on your product, or after a remote hire or new market entry.

say_en.text: I hired a remote employee in Texas. What taxes apply?
say_en.note: Claude lists registration, withholding, and nexus issues.

say_en.text: Does our SaaS need sales tax in California?
say_en.note: Claude explains service tax classification and verification.

say_en.text: We're selling in Canada. What registrations are needed?
say_en.note: Claude breaks down obligations by jurisdiction.
